sources.title: Expedia Group | Powering Global Travel with Trusted Brands

facts.claim: Expedia Group describes a travel marketplace as the core of its business.
facts.quote: At the heart of Expedia Group is a marketplace built for travelers.

facts.claim: Expedia Group describes a multi-brand portfolio covering hotels, vacation rentals, packages, and flights.
facts.quote: From hotels and vacation rentals to packages, flights, and more, our brands give travelers more ways to plan, book, and experience travel their way.

facts.claim: Expedia Group markets B2B travel technology and advertising solutions to partners.
facts.quote: Partners trust our travel tech solutions to create exceptional traveler experiences.

facts.claim: Expedia Group's careers messaging frames its environment as collaborative and globally distributed.
facts.quote: You’ll work alongside passionate global teams in a collaborative and supportive environment where people can build meaningful connections.

facts.claim: Expedia Group's official interview guide states some roles include a skills assessment, business case, or work sample.
facts.quote: For certain roles, we’ll conduct a Skills Assessment and/or request a business case or work sample.

facts.claim: Expedia Group's official interview guide states interviews include behavioral questions rooted in prior experience, structured with the STAR technique.
facts.quote: Behavioral questions rooted in prior experiences are a great way for us to understand how you behave and think.

facts.claim: Expedia Group's official interview guide states candidates are assessed against its stated Behaviors.
facts.quote: Understanding your work style against our Expedia Group Behaviors helps us understand:

signals.text: Frame JD-relevant marketplace, booking, or multi-brand consumer platform experience around Expedia Group's stated travel-marketplace positioning, when the candidate's own evidence supports it.
When JD coverage and claim safety are equal for partner-facing or B2B-scoped roles, prefer the supported bullet demonstrating platform or API work serving external business partners.
Use Expedia Group's stated collaborative, globally distributed team culture only as soft S0 framing language; never treat it as a technical requirement or keyword to insert.

Note in G3 advisory that Expedia Group's official interview guide states interviews include behavioral questions structured around the STAR technique, and that candidates are assessed against its stated Behaviors; this never changes the renderer or L7 rules.
Note in G3 advisory that Expedia Group's official interview guide states some roles add a skills assessment, business case, or work sample to the process.
